# gate-check

Arguments: `[target-phase: systems-design | technical-setup | pre-production | production | polish | release] [--review full|lean|solo]` (take them from the user's message).

This is the Codex entry point for the upstream skill
`.claude/skills/gate-check/SKILL.md`, which stays the single source of truth.

**Model tier: heavy** (gpt-6-astra, reasoning effort high).
If this session runs a different model, tell the user once, before step 1,
that this skill is rated heavy and that `/model` can switch to gpt-6-astra;
then continue on the current model unless they choose to switch.

1. Read `.claude/skills/gate-check/SKILL.md` in full before doing anything else.
2. If it has lines starting with `` !` ``, they are startup commands. Run each
   one from the repository root with `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` = `.claude/skills/gate-check`
   and treat the output as the config block the skill says is "resolved above".
   At the time of porting these were:

   ```bash
   bash ".claude/hooks/yaml-helper.sh" resolve_config --keys review_mode,workflow,qa.level,testing.strict,performance.enforce,team.size,project.stage,system_overrides
   ```

3. Follow the skill exactly, translating Claude Code vocabulary with the
   "Codex compatibility" table in `AGENTS.md`. In particular, every
